snippet.title: CHEW YOUR FOOD (Announcement Trailer)
snippet.description:
Wishlist CHEW YOUR FOOD: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4514140/CHEW_YOUR_FOOD/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=promo

CHEW YOUR FOOD is a horror game about escaping a monster's stomach after it devoured you whole.

You have to complete small puzzles, manage your resources, all the while avoiding getting chased by the monsters residing the stomach longer than you have...

This is my biggest endeavour yet. I appreciate you guys for always supporting everything that I do. If you are interested in the game, please wishlist it and share it to your horror-enthusiast friends!

Wishlist CHEW YOUR FOOD on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4514140/CHEW_YOUR_FOOD/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=promo
